entities.summary:
Masaaki Imai , 1930–⁠2023, was a Japanese organizational theorist and management consultant known for his work on quality management, specifically on kaizen. Known as the father of Continuous Improvement (CI), Masaaki Imai has been a
pioneer and leader in spreading the kaizen philosophy all over the world.
